purpose: Teach: コム/ヲタ/お稽古/絢爛/斬る/食い物/大海/面子

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがコム、つまり「.com」のお仕事のお話をして下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father will tell you about his .com work today.
lines.style: Warm, gentle introduction. Soft opening. Patient pacing like she's setting up something she knows he'll enjoy. Slight lift at the end — anticipatory but not pushing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「ヲタ」って言葉の由来を教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me where the word 'otaku' came from.
lines.style: Small, genuine pride in his voice. Not bragging — just sharing something he learned and found interesting. Clear but not loud. Natural six-year-old enthusiasm held gently.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが書道のお稽古に通わせて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father will be sending you to calligraphy lessons.
lines.style: Same gentle register. Matter-of-fact kindness — this is something good happening. Quiet confidence. No fanfare, just steady delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと絢爛豪華なお祭りを観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I saw the most gorgeous festival.
lines.style: Bright, immediate energy. Wide-eyed wonder in the voice. Quick pace — he wants to share it all at once. Genuine delight, not performed. Small-child urgency to be heard.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「悪を斬る」時代劇を一緒に観て下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father watched a samurai film with you — the one about cutting down evil.
lines.style: Same gentle, warm tone. Slight knowing quality — she understands what that story meant to him. Unhurried. A little fondness at the edges.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとおいしい食い物の食べ歩きをしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I went food tasting around the neighborhood.
lines.style: Eager, conversational. Bouncing slightly in the pacing. Real happiness — not performed. Natural child voice overlapping with memory. Wants her to see it too.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「人生は大海」って語って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father told you that life is an endless sea.
lines.style: Tender, reflective. Slower pace now — this is the important moment. Voice carries quiet weight. Landing softly on the metaphor. Almost reverent.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと麻雀の面子の意味を学んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad explained why mahjong needs four players.
lines.style: Closing statement. Small, satisfied voice. He's learned something real. Quiet competence — not bragging, just reporting what he now knows. Warm finish, like a good ending.
